This study showed that in-solution digestion is a more efficient method for LC-MS/MS analysis of kidney and liver organ perfusion solutions.

Liver perfusate samples were taken at 0, 0.5 and 8 h for one liver and at 0.5, 10 and 30 h for the other.
proteomic data obtained from both 0.5 h samples was combined (T0.5) as was the data from the 8 and 10 h samples (hereafter referred to as T9).
